sentences.text:
The Honourable Sri Justice K.Sarath
 Writ Petition No.7026 Of 2016
Order:
1. Heard the learned Counsel for the petitioners and the learned Assistant Government Pleader for Roads and Buildings appearing for the respondents.

2. The learned Counsel for the petitioners would submit that this writ petition is filed questioning the action of the respondents in trying to lay a road through the agricultural lands of the petitioners i.e. Ac.1.09 guntas, Ac.1.09 guntas, Ac.2.18 guntas and Ac.2.18 guntas in Sy.Nos.238, situated at Mungepalli Village, Kalher Mandal of Medak District (hereinafter referred to as 'subject lands'),
without following due procedure as contemplated under Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 as arbitrary and illegal and sought a direction to the respondents not to not to lay through the subject lands of the petitioners without following due process of law.
SK,J 3.

The learned Assistant Government Pleader for basing on the counter filed by the respondent No.4 would submit that the respondents have not entered into the lands of the petitioners for taking up widening work and it is not laying any new road and the road was formulated in the way back by the Panchayat Raj Department and now the respondents are widening the road within the R&B site and the work also completed.
If the petitioners have any grievance, they can make application for conducting survey and submit that the cause in the writ petition does not survive.

4. After hearing both sides and in view of the submissions made by the learned Assistant Government Pleader, this writ petition is disposed of directing the respondent authorities are not to interfere with the possession of the petitioners over the subject lands without following due process of law.

If the petitioners have any grievance, they can make application for conducting survey of the subject lands as per the existing Rules and if the respondents are found to have encroached upon the subject lands, the SK,J petitioners are at liberty to make appropriate application for payment of compensation under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
